thread:
alex_h: Heads-up — noticed our Reserved capacity for two edge sites doesn't match partner portal allocations. Customers on Dedicated will underprovision tomorrow unless we reassign.

alex_h: Reservation IDs: `resv-92734`, `resv-92735`. Our plan expected 16 GPUs each, partner portal shows 12 / 12 (so short 8 total).

maria_g: Ugh. Which vendor? Do we have their order/PO number? Need screenshot of partner portal if possible.

alex_h: Vendor = NorthEdge Cloud (vendor id NE-44). Screenshot uploaded to the thread: https://redwood.internal/attachments/shot-ne-44.png

samir_r: Can infra autoscale cover the gap overnight if we pull from central pool? what's the expected spike?

kelly_pm: Two customers on the tail-end of onboarding — one is a large PLG customer. If we can't cover, we need a short incident playbook and a note to CSMs. @rachel_partnerships please advise. :eyes:

jordan_ops: I'm opening a vendor escalation now. If vendor can reassign inventory from another rack/ETA, we can swap reservations, but need partner approval + billing alignment.

rachel_partnerships: On it — pinged NE-44 via partner slack and email. Initial reply: they're seeing a customs hold + SKU reconciliation mismatch. They propose transferring 4 GPUs from a later ETA to each site (total 8) but need our PO and confirmation by EOD.

alex_h: PO numbers: `PO-2025-1189`, `PO-2025-1190`. I'm OK approving transfer if legal/billing confirm no rate changes.

maria_g: Quick ask — can we instead pull 8 GPUs from our marketplace pool (temporary) while vendor sorts customs? That avoids customer impact. Need to check marketplace inventory and cost delta.

samir_r: Technically possible. Two quick options: 1) transfer reservations to pool-central and let autoscale handle distribution, or 2) provision marketplace instances and hand them to Dedicated via short-lived mapping. Option 2 requires billing override.

jordan_ops: I've created ticket INC-8932 and CC'd billing. Vendor asked for PO + confirmation by 1700 PST. If we can't confirm, they'll only release 2/side.

alex_h: If marketplace route is cheaper for time-to-restore, do it. We can reconcile billing after; prefer no customer outage.

rachel_partnerships: Vendor just replied: customs release ETA 48–72h, but they can shift 4 GPUs from a different US shipment arriving next week. They need our written approval and signature on amendment. I asked legal for a fast-sign.

orion-bot: Ticket INC-8932 created by jordan_ops — priority P1. Attachments: vendor_communication.pdf, partner-portal-snapshot.png.

maria_g: Samir — can you paste the internal runbook command to transfer reservations if we go that route? I'll loop billing in parallel.

samir_r: runbook snippet: ```
# transfer 4 units from resv-92735 -> pool-central
rictl reserve transfer --from resv-92735 --to pool-central --count 4 --reason "vendor-shortfall-NE44" --exec-with-approval
```

kelly_pm: Action items: 1) alex — confirm PO approval for transfer (you said yes) 2) rachel — get vendor amendment signed today if possible 3) samir/jordan — prepare marketplace fallback plan and cost estimate 4) maria — draft CSM note (temp capacity + ETA).

alex_h: Confirming PO approvals. Go ahead with vendor transfer if legal signs. If not, proceed with marketplace fallback and bill the vendor if they agreed to credits.

rachel_partnerships: Legal is on the quick-sign loop. I asked for a one-paragraph amendment. Vendor says they'll sign credit terms after the fact if customs caused the hold.

jordan_ops: I'll schedule a 15m sync at 16:00 to lock the path forward. Adding the impacted customer IDs in the private ticket.

maria_g: Thanks — prepping the CSM note. Will include two options and expected timelines.

alex_h: Thanks team — prefer marketplace fallback only if amendment can't land by EOD. Keep updates in INC-8932. :thumbsup:
